exposure: gestational age at delivery (37-38 weeks vs 39-41 weeks)
Women living at varying distances from the hospital
cohort: 638 women in rural southern Appalachia who delivered electively at or after 37 weeks' gestation.
finding: Compared to infants born at 39-41 weeks, infants delivered electively at 37-38 weeks had significantly higher risks of low birth weight, NICU admission, and jaundice.
